report_identity.report_title: China Chunlai Education Group Co., Ltd. Annual Report 2025

business_overview.one_sentence: The group operates private higher education institutions in the PRC and earns tuition and boarding fees from students.

segments.business_substance: Tuition and boarding fee revenue from PRC education institutions; school-by-school operating segments are aggregated because services, customers and regulatory environment are similar.

business_overview.revenue_model: Tuition and boarding fees are generally received in advance before the school year and recognised over the relevant semesters.
business_notes: Annual report states all revenue was generated in the PRC and all non-current assets are located in the PRC.

Revenue and profit before tax subject to contractual arrangements were approximately 100% of group totals; total assets subject to contractual arrangements were approximately 84% of group total assets.
